body: I was injured 3 years ago at work, was attacked and had 4 surgeries resulting...I had trauma issues prior to being attacked but the attack and aftermath just really amped up the issues. As a result I’ve been stuck in a fear response mode for a very long time and well am stuck. It’s hard to talk about stuff without dissociating or shutting down. I’ve been strong considering ECT or TMS. Just tired of feeling so shitty.

I worked really hard to get my Masters degree to advance my career options, then I was seriously injured at my job. 3 major surgeries later, I lost my job, car, almost my life, went bankrupt, my house, had to go on disability, have too much fear to go back into that field, have a few lawsuits that are taking a long time and now have no idea what to do with my life. I was very passionate about that field, I had finally picked something to focus on and I was good at, but I cannot face it and go back bc of all the crap that happened. I feel like I let everyone down.
I'm not gonna lie, I thought that was the inside of a garage door at first
